command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest -q -o junit_family=legacy tests/test_*conduction.py --junitxml=results.xml
reference: Two graded cells with widths 0.25 and 0.75 m, area 0.5 m², k=(1,3), C=(2,3), H=(0.75,2) in SI units. Different complex source and ambient phasors in each cell. Invert the two-cell energy equations and differentiate the numerator and determinant analytically at s=i*omega=0 for R=0,0.25,8 m² K/W. Report maximum modulus errors of temperature (K), powers and balance (W) at order 0, and corresponding first-order coefficients (K s, W s). Separate unanchored case verifies storage from total heating and the relative cell field.
